Mix powder with clean water (ratio per bag) for 3 minutes until smooth lump-free paste. Apply with stainless steel trowel in thin, uniform coats (1 - 2 mm thickness).

STAGE 1: Substrate Preparation & Priming (Before Work)
Dampen masonry or concrete wall with clean water before skimming. Level rough hollow block surfaces first with high-build render 🔗 TOFIL 801 EXTRA FS14.

STAGE 2: Main Application & Placement Schedule (Current Work)
Mix powder with clean water (ratio per bag) for 3 minutes until smooth lump-free paste. Apply with stainless steel trowel in thin, uniform coats (1 - 2 mm thickness).

STAGE 3: Detailing, Reinforcement & Joint Treatment
For hairline plaster cracks and panel seams, bridge and reinforce with 🔗 TOFIL 814 CRACK BLOCKER FS22 and embed mesh tape before final skimming.

STAGE 4: Finishing, Curing & Topcoat Protection (After Work / Until Finish)
Allow 12-24 hours drying. Sand smooth with 240-grit sandpaper and touch up pinholes with 🔗 TOFIL 807 PUTTY MASTER FS19. Prime and paint with approved wall coating system.
